'''Nilim Bril''' was a male [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in the city of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] with his niece [[Numa/Legends|Numa]].

==Biography==
[[File:Bril_Kenobi.jpg|left|thumb||160px|Nilim Bril is freed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].]]
After [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] member [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Nilim, along with the rest of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], was captured by [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|Tactical droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] and used as a "living shield" against the Republic army, as the tactical droid believed that the Republic would not put innocent lives at risk.

After learning of the Twi'leks' capture, [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met his niece [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], and she led him through the underground passages to the hostages. Along with [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], Obi-Wan was able to free Nilim and the rest of the Twi'leks, and Nilim was reunited with Numa. After Obi-Wan, Waxer and Boil were blasted aside by TX-20's [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tank]], Numa ran to help them, and inspired by her courage, Nilim led the Twi'leks in an attack on the tactical droid, and they were able to destroy him.
